Liana review: digital legacy verdict

By the Afterkeep research team · Reviewed on 15 Oct 2026 · Independent: sponsors can't buy a verdict · How we rate

Verdict: A free, open-source bitcoin wallet from Wizardsardine with time-based recovery paths, so a family member or trusted contact can access funds if something happens to you. Best for: Technical bitcoin holders who want DIY inheritance with no company holding keys.

Good

Technical bitcoin holders who want DIY inheritance with no company holding keys.

Pros

  • Free and open source
  • Time-based recovery path for heirs
  • No third party holds your keys

Cons

  • DIY setup with community support only (free edition)
  • Bitcoin only
  • Heirs must follow the recovery path themselves

Frequently asked questions

Is Liana good for digital legacy planning?

A free, open-source bitcoin wallet from Wizardsardine with time-based recovery paths, so a family member or trusted contact can access funds if something happens to you.

Who is Liana best for?

Technical bitcoin holders who want DIY inheritance with no company holding keys.

How much does Liana cost?

Liana Wallet is free and open source; Liana Business is a paid service.

What are the downsides of Liana?

DIY setup with community support only (free edition); Bitcoin only; Heirs must follow the recovery path themselves.

What are alternatives to Liana?

Alternatives in the same category include Casa, Unchained, Vault12 Guard.
